issues.description: The script requests @connect permission for translate.googleapis.com and grants GM_xmlhttpRequest, but no actual data transmission to third-party servers is present in the provided code. If future code uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to send user data to this or other domains, it could pose a risk.
issues.recommendation: Ensure that any network requests do not transmit sensitive user data. Limit @connect and GM_xmlhttpRequest usage to only necessary and trusted endpoints.

issues.description: The script uses @require to load turndown from unpkg.com, a widely used CDN, but does not pin to a specific file hash. This exposes the script to supply chain risks if the CDN is compromised or the file is updated.
issues.recommendation: Pin to a specific file hash or use a trusted, immutable CDN to prevent supply chain attacks.
